about.title: About Print 8
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner for professional printing.
about.story: Print 8 is a company dedicated to high-quality printing and personalized products. With modern equipment and experience, we turn your ideas into reality — from simple business cards to complex gift sets.
about.websiteBody: Print 8 is an online print shop based in Štip, North Macedonia. Order personalized apparel, drinkware, invitations, print services, and more — with cargo delivery or store pickup.
about.accountsBody: A free Print 8 account gives you order history, loyalty points, and secure sign-in with Google or email. Points rules and account terms are described in our Terms & Conditions and on the loyalty points page.
about.missionText: To provide accessible, quality printing services with a focus on customer satisfaction and fast delivery.
about.qualityDesc: Every project gets our full attention.
about.trustDesc: Pay on delivery — no risk for you.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about orders, payment, and delivery.

payment.a: You pay on cargo delivery or when you pick up in store. Order online — pay when you receive or collect your product.

formats.q: What file formats do you accept?
formats.a: We accept PDF, JPG, and PNG. For best results, use at least 300 DPI.

delivery.a: Standard cargo delivery is 2–3 business days. For urgent orders, contact us.

production.a: For standard orders, printing is fast and fits within the delivery window. Longer production time applies only to very large orders — we will let you know in advance.

custom.q: Can I create my own design?
custom.a: Yes! Use our design studio or upload your file when ordering.

minimum.a: It depends on the service. Business cards minimum is 100 pieces, t-shirts — 1 piece.

loyaltyPoints.pillarsSubtitle: No hidden tiers or complicated math — just shop, deliver, and save.

earn.title: Earn on every order
earn.body: Logged-in customers earn points from the cash amount you pay (after coupons and any points discount). Every full 100 MKD paid adds more points to your balance.

pending.title: Pending until delivery
pending.body: Points appear on your account immediately after you order, but stay pending until the order is marked delivered or picked up. That keeps the program fair if an order is cancelled.

redeem.title: Redeem at checkout
redeem.body: Use your ready balance on the next order. Choose how many points to apply — we calculate the MKD discount for you. You can cover up to the full order subtotal after coupons.

loyaltyPoints.stepsSubtitle: From sign-up to savings in four steps.

account.title: Create your account
account.body: Register with your email. It’s free and takes less than a minute. Guest checkout is still available, but only accounts earn and spend points.

shop.title: Shop as usual
shop.body: Pick products, ready designs, or print services. Personalize, add to cart, and review your preview before checkout.

checkout.title: Checkout with points
checkout.body: At checkout you’ll see how many points you’ll earn on this order. If you have a ready balance, apply points for an instant MKD discount.

delivery.title: Delivery unlocks points
delivery.body: When your order is delivered or picked up, pending points move to your ready balance. Your first delivered order also unlocks the one-time welcome bonus.

example.title: See the math
example.intro: Imagine your first order totals 1,000 MKD in cash after any coupon — here’s what you’d see:
example.redeemNote: Once delivered, those points become ready. Later, {points} points could take {amount} MKD off a future order.
example.redeemBody: Each point is worth {value} MKD off. We only charge the points needed for the discount you get.

guest.q: Can I earn points as a guest?
guest.a: No — you need a free account so we can track your balance. You can still order as a guest, but you won’t earn or redeem points.

pending.a: Points stay pending until delivery or store pickup so cancelled orders don’t award points. You’ll see the same total at checkout and in your account.

expire.a: Your ready balance stays on your account until you use it. We may update program rules in future, but we’ll always communicate changes clearly.

combine.q: Can I use points with coupons?
combine.a: Yes. Coupons apply first; points discount the remaining subtotal. You earn points on the cash amount you actually pay.

loyaltyPoints.alsoBody: Try our spin wheel for surprise discounts, or read the short ordering guide if you’re new to Print 8.

howToOrder.title: How to order
howToOrder.subtitle: A short guide — no complicated tools. Everything happens online.

choose.title: Choose what you want
choose.body: Open Products for tees and mugs, Print designs for invites and cards, or Services for laminating, binding, and more.

personalize.title: Personalize or pick a ready design
personalize.body: Order a ready photo design, upload your own photo and text, or fill a template with your details. The preview shows what we print.

checkout.title: Complete checkout
checkout.body: Add to cart, choose cargo delivery or store pickup, and confirm. You don't pay online.

receive.title: Get your product
receive.body: We'll contact you to confirm. Cargo usually takes 2–3 business days. In Shtip you can pick up in store. Pay on delivery or pickup.
